mapper.select: SELECT pm.mk_id, pm.mb_id, pm.place_name, pm.subject, pm.contents, pm.tag_nm, pm.mk_type, pm.mk_status, pm.mk_price, pm.address, pm.longitude, pm.latitude, CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pet_market_like_mapping WHERE mk_id = pm.mk_id AND mb_id = #{mbId}) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS like_fl, JSON_ARRAYAGG( JSON_OBJECT( 'mkFmId', g5bf.mk_fm_id, 'imageUrl', g5bf.bf_fileurl, 'fileName', g5bf.bf_source ) ) AS image_list, pm.create_ymd, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pet_market_like_mapping WHERE mk_id = pm.mk_id) AS like_cnt, (SELECT gbf.bf_fileurl FROM g5_board_file gbf WHERE gbf.bo_table = 'user_profile' AND gm.mb_id = pm.mb_id AND gm.mb_no = gbf.wr_id) AS profile_url, gm.mb_nick, vml.level, vml.level_nm, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pet_member_manage_history WHERE use_type = 1 AND mb_id = pm.mb_id AND target_mb_id = #{mbId}) AS isReportFl FROM pet_market pm INNER JOIN g5_member gm ON pm.mb_id = gm.mb_id LEFT JOIN v_member_level vml ON pm.mb_id = vml.mb_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT pmfm.mk_id, pmfm.mk_fm_id, g5bf.bf_fileurl, g5bf.bf_source FROM pet_market_file_mapping pmfm LEFT JOIN g5_board_file g5bf ON pmfm.mk_fm_id = g5bf.wr_id AND g5bf.bo_table = 'pet_market' ORDER BY g5bf.wr_id ) g5bf ON pm.mk_id = g5bf.mk_id WHERE pm.del_fl = 0 AND fn_block_member(#{mbId},pm.mb_id) < 1 AND pm.mk_id = #{mkId};

SELECT SQL_CALC_FOUND_ROWS ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY purchase_status, create_ymd) AS row_num, purchase_id, mk_id, purchase_mb_id, contents, purchase_status, CASE WHEN purchase_status = 1 THEN '구매 확정' ELSE '구매 요청중' END AS purchase_status_nm FROM pet_market_purchase WHERE del_fl = 0 AND mk_id = #{mkId} ORDER BY purchase_status, create_ymd DESC LIMIT #{pageNo}, #{pageSize};
mapper.update: UPDATE pet_market_purchase SET purchase_status = 1 WHERE purchase_id = #{purchaseId};
mapper.select: SELECT purchase_mb_id FROM pet_market_purchase WHERE purchase_id = #{purchaseId};
mapper.update: UPDATE pet_market SET mk_status = 1 WHERE mk_id = #{mkId};
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pet_market ( mb_id, place_name, subject, contents, tag_nm, mk_type, mk_status, mk_price, address, longitude, latitude ) VALUES ( #{mbId}, #{placeName}, #{subject}, #{contents}, #{tagNm}, #{mkType}, #{mkStatus}, #{mkPrice}, #{address}, #{longitude}, #{latitude} );
mapper.select: SELECT mk_fm_id FROM pet_market_file_mapping WHERE mk_id = #{mkId};
mapper.update: UPDATE pet_market SET place_name = #{placeName}, subject = #{subject}, contents = #{contents}, tag_nm = #{tagNm}, mk_type = #{mkType}, mk_status = #{mkStatus}, mk_price = #{mkPrice}, address = #{address}, longitude = #{longitude}, latitude = #{latitude} WHERE mk_id = #{mkId};
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM pet_market_like_mapping WHERE mk_id = #{mkId} AND mb_id = #{mbId};
DELETE FROM pet_member_block_mapping WHERE mb_id = #{mbId} AND mbm_id = #{mbmId};
DELETE FROM pet_member_report_mapping WHERE mb_id = #{mbId} AND mrm_id = #{mrmId};
DELETE FROM pet_member_manage_history WHERE mb_id = #{mbId} AND use_mapping_id = #{mbmId};
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pet_member_manage_history ( use_type, use_mapping_id, mb_id, target_mb_id, read_fl, subject, contents ) VALUES ( #{useType}, #{useMappingId}, #{mbId}, #{targetMbId}, #{readFl}, #{subject}, #{contents} );

INSERT INTO pet_member_block_report_history ( crud_type, use_type, use_mapping_id, mb_id, target_mb_id, read_fl, subject, contents, create_id ) VALUES ( #{crudType}, #{useType}, #{useMappingId}, #{mbId}, #{targetMbId}, #{readFl}, #{subject}, #{contents}, #{createId} );
mapper.delete: INSERT INTO pet_member_block_report_history ( crud_type, use_type, use_mapping_id, mb_id, target_mb_id, read_fl, subject, contents, create_id ) SELECT 'DELETED', use_type, use_mapping_id, mb_id, target_mb_id, read_fl, subject, contents, #{mbId} FROM pet_member_manage_history WHERE use_type = 2 AND use_mapping_id = #{useMappingId};
mapper.select: SELECT mb_nick FROM g5_member WHERE mb_id = #{mbId};
